Yes: switching wins 2/3 of the time, staying 1/3. Your first pick is right 1/3 of the time, and the host's reveal doesn't change that, so the remaining 2/3 lands on the one other closed door.

This assumes the standard rules: the host knows where the car is, always opens a goat door you didn't pick, and always offers the switch. If the host opens a door at random and it happens to show a goat, switching and staying are each 1/2. If the host offers the switch only when you've picked the car, switching always loses.
